== Usage ==
A '''Wisp Upgrade Stone''' of the correct rarity can be used to upgrade a {{Item|Wisp Pet}} to the next rarity, resetting its level to {{Green|1}}.

The pet must be level {{Green|80}} or higher to be upgraded. It is recommended to stop leveling the pet up when it reaches level {{Green|80}}, unless if it is a {{Item|Subzero Wisp Pet}}.

== Trivia ==
* Upgrading a {{Item|Droplet Wisp Pet}} to a certain rarity requires the following materials:
** {{Rare}}: {{Item|Enchanted Packed Ice|amount=3}}, {{Item|Kelvin Inverter|amount=1}}s, {{Item|Inferno Vertex|amount=1|text=Inferno Vertices}} and {{Item|Molten Powder|amount=8}}.
** {{Epic}}: {{Item|Enchanted Packed Ice|amount=15}}, {{Item|Kelvin Inverter|amount=7}}s, {{Item|Inferno Vertex|amount=9|text=Inferno Vertices}} and {{Item|Molten Powder|amount=56}}.
** {{Legendary}}: {{Item|Enchanted Packed Ice|amount=79}}, {{Item|Kelvin Inverter|amount=7}}s, {{Item|Inferno Vertex|amount=25|text=Inferno Vertices}}, {{Item|Molten Powder|amount=184}}, {{Item|Bluetooth Ring|amount=2}}s, {{Item|Subzero Inverter|amount=1}} and {{Item|Inferno Apex|amount=1}}.
* '''Wisp Upgrade Stones''' can be used without meeting their craft requirements.
* '''Wisp Upgrade Stones''' cannot be {{Item|Recombobulator 3000|text=recombobulated}}. If one is already recombobulated, it will be forcibly reverted to its base rarity.
** Previously, players would recombobulate them to scam other players, as recombobulating them made them falsely appear as a higher tier upgrade stone.
